description: This file is a server-side JavaScript source code implementing an Express.js application that provides a web interface and API endpoints for visualizing and interacting with multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It includes logic for loading environment variables, configuring database clients, defining database adapter classes, testing connections, and handling API requests.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database adapters, providing interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and fetching data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, providing common SQL execution and query methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing methods to query table info and data.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing methods to query table info and data.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing methods to query table info and data.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing methods to list collections and retrieve data.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from specific .env files for different database types.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and reports which are available.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing operations on specified database adapters.
